lines.en: label yumispring10:
scene yumifirstrealkiss1
She doesn’t have to {i}lead{/i} for long as the main benefit to her living in Chika’s old place is that I know exactly where everything is.
lines.zh: 她其实不用{i}带{/i}太久的路——她住在 Chika 以前那个地方最大的好处就是，我闭着眼睛都知道每样东西放在哪儿。

lines.en: Every light switch, every soft spot on the floor that makes me question whether or not it can support someone of my weight, every zabuton I’ve internally catalogued in order of most to least comfortable.
lines.zh: 每一盏灯的开关，地板上每一处让我怀疑能不能撑住我这体重的软塌，还有每一个被我在心里按舒适度从高到低排好序的坐垫。

lines.en: Of course, the main setback to Yumi living here is that any memory I’m fortunate enough {i}to{/i} make with her will come on the wings of betrayal — even if Chika’s too far gone to think of it that way anymore.
lines.zh: 当然，Yumi 住在这里最大的坏处是——我{i}能{/i}有幸和她一起留下的任何回忆，都会乘着背叛的翅膀而来……哪怕 Chika 已经走得够远，不会再那样想了。

lines.en: I can still picture it clearly when I purge the more lascivious images from my kaleidoscopic mind.
lines.zh: 每当我把这颗万花筒般的脑子里那些更淫靡的画面清除掉时，我依然能清晰地看见它。

lines.en: I see them sitting here — gathered around the chabudai with groceries picked up after 7:00 PM when the discounts kick in.
lines.zh: 我看见她们坐在这里——围坐在矮桌（chabudai）旁，身边堆着晚上七点之后打折时买回来的食材。

lines.en: {size=-2}Yumi is reading manga. Chinami is playing games on her phone. Chika’s painting her nails watching some variety show on TV. Probably one featuring my childhood friend turned girlfriend turned ex turned girlfriend again.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}Yumi 在看漫画。Chinami 在手机上打游戏。Chika 一边涂指甲油一边看电视上的综艺节目。大概还是那种有我那位青梅竹马变女友、变前女友、又变回女友出场的节目。{/size}

lines.en: And I’m not there.
lines.zh: 而我不在那里。

lines.en: I’m somewhere else.
lines.zh: 我在别的地方。

lines.en: Probably home, eating something Ami made for me. Maybe I’m at the shrine with Maya. Maybe I’m sparring with Ayane again. I don’t know.
lines.zh: 大概在家，吃着 Ami 给我做的东西。也可能我和 Maya 在神社。也可能我又在和 Ayane 对练。我不知道。

lines.en: I’ve never been good at envisioning fantasies with me in them because it tends to make all of them worse. And the amount of space in my head is best reserved for happier things these days.
lines.zh: 我向来不擅长把自己也画进幻想里，因为那往往只会让一切变得更糟。而我脑子里这点空间，如今最好还是留给更快乐的事。

lines.en: It’s my body that disagrees with that. And this cursed muscle in my chest called a “heart” that I never figured out how to connect to the part of me that actually makes my decisions.
lines.zh: 不同意这一点的是我的身体。还有我胸口这块被诅咒的、名叫「心脏」的肌肉——我始终没弄明白该怎么把它和我真正做决定的那部分连在一起。

lines.en: Which part that is changes with the weather. And if there’s anything I know about Kumon-mi, it’s that the weather rarely changes at all.
lines.zh: 至于那部分到底是哪个，随天气而变。而要说我对 Kumon-mi 有什么了解的话，那就是这里的天气几乎从不改变。

lines.en: : Here.
I have my moments. Everyone does.
lines.zh: 我也有这样的时刻。每个人都有。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: : Turns out I did have some tea left after all.
lines.zh: : 结果发现我还真剩了点茶。

lines.en: scene black
scene yumifirstrealkiss2
: It’s just gross ass houjicha, though. I hate that shit, so Chika must have forgotten to take it with her when she moved out. Tea doesn’t go bad, does it?
lines.zh: : 不过是难喝得要死的焙茶。我超讨厌那玩意儿，所以肯定是 Chika 搬走时忘带了。茶不会坏吧？

lines.en: But the moments where my heart {i}does{/i} dictate my actions typically feel more monumental than this.
lines.zh: 但那些由着心跳替我{i}做主{/i}的时刻，感觉通常比此刻要重大得多。

lines.en: This just feels {i}normal{/i} even when it’s anything but. Like any other day. Like two people sitting at a chabudai drinking tea and wanting to connect but not fully understanding how.
lines.zh: 此刻却感觉再{i}平常{/i}不过，哪怕它绝不平常。就像任何其他的一天。就像两个人坐在矮桌旁喝茶，想要靠近彼此，却不太明白该怎么做。

lines.en: With Chika, there was guidance. There was someone who could take these things and bend them into something beautiful.
lines.zh: 和 Chika 在一起的时候，是有指引的。有人能把这些东西掰开折拢，变成某种美好的形状。

lines.en: My hands aren’t meant for that. The only reshaping {i}I{/i} do comes in the form of symbolically decapitating Barbie dolls and then showing their headless, naked bodies to an army of my other plastic corpses.
lines.zh: 我的手不是干这个的。{i}我{/i}唯一会做的「重塑」，就是象征性地把芭比娃娃斩首，再把她们无头赤裸的尸体摆给我那支塑料尸体大军看。

lines.en: Yumi won’t lead. And I {i}can’t{/i} lead someone like her. She’s not as malleable. She’s stiff and she’ll break if I’m not careful enough. I can’t stomach another {i}head{/i} in my hands.
lines.zh: Yumi 不会领路。而我也{i}领不了{/i}她这样的人。她没那么容易被塑形。她很僵硬，我要是不够小心，她就会折断。我再也无法忍受又一颗{i}脑袋{/i}落进我手里。

lines.en: scene aboxabox43
scene yumifirstrealkiss3
: If you’re going to start getting weird and blacking out again or whatever, let me know now so I can go lock myself in the bathroom and wait until it’s over.
lines.zh: : 你要是又开始发神经、断片什么的，现在就告诉我，我好去把自己锁在厕所里，等你折腾完。

lines.en: : No, I...I’m fine. Thank you for the tea. Again. I much appreciate the flavors of forgotten houjicha.
lines.zh: : 不，我……我没事。谢谢你的茶。再一次。我十分感激这被遗忘的焙茶的风味。

lines.en: : My bad, dude. I ain’t exactly used to having company.
lines.zh: : 我的错啦，老兄。我确实不太习惯家里有客人。

lines.en: : None at all? So Chika doesn’t ever come back over here? What about Noriko?
lines.zh: : 一个都没有？所以 Chika 从没回来过这儿？Noriko 呢？

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss4
: Noriko came over, like...once. Chika’s too busy now between work and being a literal fucking psychopath. So if I ever see her, it’s at her place.
lines.zh: : Noriko 来过，就……一次。Chika 现在太忙了，工作和当个彻头彻尾的疯子两头跑。所以我要见她，都是去她那边。

lines.en: : Are you guys back to normal yet? I know she was still kind of...{i}off{/i} when stuff started happening with your mom. Otherwise you would have called her instead of me.
lines.zh: : 你们俩恢复正常了吗？我知道你妈妈出事那阵子她还有点……{i}不太对劲{/i}。不然你当时会打电话给她而不是我。

lines.en: : It’s...complicated. Like, I want to be friends with her again and shit. I’m just not really sure what my place in her life {i}is{/i} anymore, you know?
lines.zh: : 挺……复杂的。{i}就是{/i}，我是想跟她重新做朋友之类的。可我实在不确定现在我在她生活里算什么了，你懂吗？

lines.en: : Not really. Elaborate?
lines.zh: : 不太懂。展开说说？

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss5
: Well, like...you do know she almost killed me that one time when she thought you and I were doing shit behind her back, right?
lines.zh: : 那个，就是……你知道她有一次以为你和我背地里搞在一起，差点杀了我，对吧？

lines.en: : Right. Which is now a thing she knows I’m doing with a bunch of {i}other{/i} people who she has yet to actually murder on account of Olympic level mental gymnastics.
lines.zh: : 对。而现在，她知道我在和一堆{i}别的{/i}人做同样的事，却还没真的动手杀人——全靠奥运级别的脑内体操。

lines.en: : Right. But she and I were actually {i}close.{/i} So what’s she going to think when she finds out I actually like you now?
lines.zh: : 对。可她和我以前是真{i}亲近{/i}。所以等她发现我现在其实喜欢你，她会怎么想？

lines.en: : Excuse me. Could you repeat that, please?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。能请你再说一遍吗？

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss6
: L...Like as a...person! Or whatever! Not like I actually {i}like{/i} you, like you. I never said love.
lines.zh: : 就……就当是……当个人！之类的！又不是我真的{i}喜欢{/i}你、喜欢你那样！我又没说爱。

lines.en: : Well, if it’s just that, I’m sure she’d be happy. She’s been trying to get you and I closer from the start, hasn’t she?
lines.zh: : 如果只是这样，我相信她会高兴的。她从一开始就一直想让你和我走得更近，不是吗？

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss7
: I {i}guess...{/i}But part of me feels like she was only doing that because she knew I wouldn’t actually bite.
lines.zh: : {i}大概{/i}是吧……可我心里有一部分觉得，她那么做只是因为她知道我根本不会真的咬钩。

lines.en: : Yet here you are — inviting me inside. And all it took was sexual assault, a few apocalypses, and your mom getting cancer. And people say I don’t have game.
lines.zh: : 可你看看现在——把我请进屋里来了。而走到这一步所需要的，不过是一次性侵、几次世界末日，还有你妈妈得了癌症。居然还有人说我不会撩。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss8
: Literally nobody says that. You’re so fucking popular among teenagers that somebody might think {i}you{/i} were an idol too if they didn’t know any better.
lines.zh: : 根本没人这么说。你在青少年里红得要命，不知情的人搞不好还以为{i}你{/i}也是个偶像呢。

lines.en: : I can’t be an idol. It’d give my girlfriend one less thing to lord over me if we were equal on that ground.
lines.zh: : 我当不了偶像。要是在这点上我们平起平坐，我女朋友就少一样能拿来压我的东西了。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss9
: Yeah...that’s another thing that makes me question whether or not trying to go back to “normal” with Chika would really work right now. She’s...got a lot going on too.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这也是让我怀疑现在跟 Chika 强行回到「正常」到底行不行的另一点。她……也有很多事要操心。

lines.en: : And we both know I ain’t exactly a good influence. So chances are I’d just make shit worse if I tried to be there for her or whatever.
lines.zh: : 而且我们俩都知道，我可算不上什么好影响。所以如果我真去陪在她身边什么的，八成只会把事情搞得更糟。

lines.en: : Right. But we also know she loves you so much that she tried to infiltrate the literal Yakuza just to get you back, so I wouldn’t really understate how much something like this {i}could{/i} mean to her.
lines.zh: : 话是没错。但我们也知道她有多爱你——她为了把你弄回来，可是去渗透了货真价实的黑道。所以我不会低估这种事对她而言{i}意味着{/i}什么。

lines.en: : I just ain’t really sure what to say, you know? Like I obviously ain’t into girls or whatever, but it feels kind of like we {i}broke up{/i} and are just...acquaintances now.
lines.zh: : 我只是真的不知道该说什么，你懂吗？就是，我当然不是喜欢女生什么的，可这感觉有点像我们{i}分手{/i}了，现在只是……熟人而已。

lines.en: : Which sucks extra hard for me since it means {i}you{/i} of all people are probably the one I’m closest to all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 而这对我来说格外难受，因为这意味着突然之间，我最亲近的人竟然是{i}你{/i}这家伙。

lines.en: : Don’t let Noriko hear you say that. She’s your new girlfriend now that Chika’s been sidelined.
lines.zh: : 别让 Noriko 听见你说这话。Chika 退场之后，她现在就是你的新女友了。

lines.en: : And you’re, like...actually {i}calling{/i} Noriko’s sister your girlfriend now, huh?
lines.zh: : 而你……就真的管 Noriko 的姐姐{i}叫{/i}女朋友了，是吧？

lines.en: : To be fair, it’s not like I have much of a choice when she plastered it all over social media. But...yeah. That’s what I’m calling her. She’s earned it.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，她把这事儿刷遍了社交媒体，我也没多少选择。不过……嗯。我就这么叫了。她配得上。

lines.en: : How?
lines.zh: : 凭什么？

lines.en: : Well, you know how much you’ve hated putting up with me over the few years we’ve known each other? Take that and multiply it by like...I don’t know. A lot.
lines.zh: : 你知道我们认识这几年，你有多受不了我吧？把那个乘以……我不知道，很多倍。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss10
: Can’t tell what’s worse — having to go through Hell for so long or getting {i}you{/i} as the consolation prize.
lines.zh: : 说不上哪个更糟——是熬了那么久的地狱，还是最后拿到{i}你{/i}这个安慰奖。

lines.en: : Exactly. Which is why I’ve decided to just let her have this if she’s so set on wanting it.
lines.zh: : 正是。所以我决定了，既然她这么想要，那就让给她。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t know the girl. But if she’s anything like Noriko, it only makes sense that she’d be dumb enough to want something as {i}un-wantable{/i} as you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不认识那女孩。但如果她有半点像 Noriko，那她蠢到会想要你这么个{i}没人要{/i}的东西，也就说得通了。

lines.en: : If I’m so un-wantable, why did you kiss me in a love hotel?
lines.zh: : 如果我真这么没人要，你为什么在情人旅馆亲我？

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss11
: You probably drugged me. That’s the only explanation I can think of, so...
lines.zh: : 你八成给我下药了。这是我能想到的唯一解释，所以……

lines.en: : Also, it was on your fucking cheek. Only a fucking...virgin loser would get excited over something like that.
lines.zh: : 再说，那可是亲在你的破脸上。只有那种……处女loser 才会为这种事兴奋。

lines.en: : Yumi, I have some news that might surprise you.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我有个消息可能会让你惊讶。

lines.en: : Yes, Sensei. I know you’re not {i}actually{/i} a virgin. I have already conceded that a bunch of the fucking idiots we know were stupid enough to let you do shit to ‘em.
lines.zh: : 是，Sensei。我知道你{i}其实{/i}不是处男。我已经承认过了，我们认识的那一堆白痴里，确实有不少蠢到让你对她们动手动脚。

lines.en: : You still {i}feel{/i} like a virgin, though. And it makes me feel good when I insult you, so I’m going to keep doing it even if I know I am technically wrong.
lines.zh: : 可你给人的{i}感觉{/i}还是像个处男。而且骂你让我很爽，所以就算我知道技术上我是错的，我也会继续骂下去。

lines.en: : Which is totally fair. And also why I can say you’re in love with me even if I know {i}I{/i} am technically wrong.
lines.zh: : 完全合理。这也正是为什么{i}我{/i}可以说你爱上我了——哪怕我知道技术上我是错的。

lines.en: : Yumi?
lines.zh: : Yumi？

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss12
: What if I, like...{i}was,{/i} though?
lines.zh: : 可如果……我{i}就是{/i}呢？

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Like...we both {i}know{/i} you’re not a virgin. But you can’t know for sure that I don’t feel that way about you, right? So it could be, like...really insensitive to say something like that to me if I actually was.
lines.zh: : 就是……我们都{i}知道{/i}你不是处男。但你没法百分百确定我对你的感觉不是那样，对吧？所以如果我真的是，你对我说那种话，可能就……真的很伤人。

lines.en: : Well...sure. But at a certain point, that would kind of be {i}your{/i} fault, wouldn’t it? Like you’ve had more than enough opportunities to indicate to me that you have actual feelings and don’t just hate me.
lines.zh: : 嗯……当然。但到了某个地步，那不就有点是{i}你自己{/i}的问题了吗？你有的是机会向我表明你对我有真正的感情，而不只是讨厌我。

lines.en: : I’ve told you plenty of times I don’t hate you. I just don’t {i}love{/i} you either. So I’m somewhere in between.
lines.zh: : 我说过很多次我不讨厌你了。只是我也不{i}爱{/i}你。所以我介于两者之间。

lines.en: : Right. Which is why-
lines.zh: : 对。所以说——

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss13
: Hypothetically, though...
lines.zh: : 不过，假设一下……

lines.en: : Would anything even change if I {i}did{/i} feel that way?
lines.zh: : 如果我{i}真的{/i}有那种感觉，事情会有什么改变吗？

lines.en: : You have an actual girlfriend now. Both of my friends like you. My {i}mom{/i} probably likes you. So {i}me{/i} liking you too would just...that would suck for everybody, right?
lines.zh: : 你现在有正式的女朋友了。我两个朋友都喜欢你。我{i}妈{/i}大概也喜欢你。所以连{i}我{/i}也喜欢上你……那对所有人来说都很糟，对吧？

lines.en: : Like, the only one of those girls I can compete with in anything is my fucking mom and that’s just because she’s a rapidly decaying junkie bitch.
lines.zh: : 就是，那群女生里我唯一能在任何方面比一比的，就是我那个妈，而那还只是因为她是个急速腐烂的瘾君子贱人。

lines.en: : And I, like...you can call me a fucking loser or whatever since I’m about to sound like a virgin too, but...I don’t think I’d be as good at mental gymnastics as Chika. Or as...motivated as Noriko.
lines.zh: : 然后我……你可以叫我什么loser 之类的，因为我接下来这话听着也像个处女，但……我不觉得自己能像 Chika 那样擅长脑内体操。也不像 Noriko 那么……有干劲。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be okay with just...{i}doing{/i} stuff or whatever. I’d want to, like...{i}actually{/i} date somebody if I had feelings for them. Hypothetically, obviously. And you’d be a terrible choice for that.
lines.zh: : 我没法接受只是……{i}做{/i}那种事之类的。如果我{i}真的{/i}对谁有感觉，我会想……真正地和那个人谈恋爱。当然是假设。而在这方面，你会是极糟糕的选择。

lines.en: : Yeah...I would. So it’s for the {i}best{/i} if you don’t feel that way about me. And that you stick to your guns if you feel like it’s ever on the verge of happening.
lines.zh: : 是……我会。所以你{i}最好{/i}别对我有那种感觉。而且如果感觉快要冒头了，你得咬死了不松口。

lines.en: : Yet here I am...inviting you inside.
lines.zh: : 可我现在……还是把你请进来了。

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: : Yumi——

lines.en: : I don’t regret it, you know.
lines.zh: : 我不后悔，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Don’t regret...what?
lines.zh: : 不后悔……什么？

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss14
: K...Kissing you...
lines.zh: : 亲……亲了你……

lines.en: : Again, it was just on the cheek. And you were, like...there for me and shit. So...let’s just say you earned that the same way Noriko’s sister earned the right to date you or whatever.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，那只是亲在脸上而已。而且你那时候……有陪着我之类的。所以……就当是你也配得上吧，跟 Noriko 的姐姐配得上和你交往是一个道理。

lines.en: : Just don’t fucking make fun of me for it or I’ll rip your balls off. Got it?
lines.zh: : 只是别他妈拿这事取笑我，不然我把你蛋扯下来。懂吗？

lines.en: : Can I sit a little closer to you?
lines.zh: : 我能坐得离你近一点吗？

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss15
: W...What? Are we not close enough already? Why?
lines.zh: : 什……什么？我们现在还不够近吗？为什么？

lines.en: : I can’t reach you from here.
lines.zh: : 我从这里够不到你。

lines.en: : Why...would you need to reach me? I’m okay right now. I don’t need to be, like...comforted again or anything.
lines.zh: : 你为什么……需要够到我？我现在很好。我不需要再被……安慰什么的。

lines.en: : I’m not looking to comfort you. I’m just trying to be proactive here since I think we both {i}want{/i} to be closer and you’re too stubborn to come out and say it.
lines.zh: : 我不是想安慰你。我只是想主动一点，因为我觉得我们俩都{i}想{/i}靠得更近，而你太倔了，不肯说出口。

lines.en: : You...want to be closer to me?
lines.zh: : 你……想和我更亲近？

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss16

: Well, I mean, like...{i}obviously{/i} you want to be closer to me. You’ve dedicated your entire life to trying to get into my pants. But, like...doing that right after I said I’m not really...{i}like{/i} that is...fucked up, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我是说，就……你 {i}obviously{/i} 想跟我更亲近。你把整个人生都奉献给了「钻进我裤子里」这件事。可我刚说完我不是那种……那样的人，你紧接着就做这个……也太操蛋了吧？

lines.en: : Is me doing something fucked up really {i}that{/i} out of the question?
lines.zh: : 我做点操蛋的事，真的{i}那么{/i}不可思议吗？

lines.en: : Well, no...but-
lines.zh: : 嗯，不是……可是——

lines.en: : Besides, if I ever {i}did{/i} make some sort of actual move on you, one that I’m entirely conscious for, it would be because I think you’re special. Not because I just want to {i}get in your pants.{/i}
lines.zh: : 再说，如果我{i}真{/i}对你采取了什么实质的行动——那种我完全清醒时做的——那也是因为我觉得你很特别。而不是因为我只想着{i}钻进你的裤子{/i}。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss17
: That’s something else you probably shouldn’t say...Like...in the event that I {i}do{/i} actually like you or whatever.
lines.zh: : 这也是你大概不该说的话……就是……万一我{i}真的{/i}喜欢你之类的。

lines.en: : That’s it. I’m coming over there.
lines.zh: : 就这样。我过去了。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss18
: D...Do whatever you want. It’s not like I...actually care or anything...
lines.zh: : 随……随你的便。我又不是……真的在意什么的……

lines.en: : Spoken like a true tsundere.
lines.zh: : 说这话的口气，真是个标准的傲娇。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss19
: Don’t call me fucking tsundere. You being into girls who are mean to you doesn’t automatically mean that anyone who {i}is{/i} just wants to fuck you.
lines.zh: : 别他妈叫我傲娇。你喜欢对你凶的女孩，不代表所{i}有{/i}对你凶的女孩都想上你。

lines.en: : Who said anything about fucking? We’ve already established that you’re looking for a traditional romantic relationship full of hugs and kisses and hand-holding, right?
lines.zh: : 谁说上床了？我们已经说定了，你要的是那种充满拥抱、亲吻和牵手的传统恋爱关系，对吧？

lines.en: : I made you tea. You’re not allowed to make fun of me.
lines.zh: : 我给你泡了茶。你不准取笑我。

lines.en: : If I did something right now, would you be mad at me?
lines.zh: : 如果我现在做点什么，你会生我的气吗？

lines.en: : Depends on...what you did, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那得看……你做什么吧，我想。

lines.en: : Look at me.
lines.zh: : 看着我。

lines.en: : No. You’re gross and it’ll make me puke.
lines.zh: : 不要。你很恶心，看了会吐。

lines.en: : Okay. I’ll just go home then.
lines.zh: : 好。那我就直接回家了。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss20
: No! That-
lines.zh: : 不要！那——

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss21
: You know, when I first sat down at the chabudai tonight, I had this whole inner monologue about how it feels wrong to be here with you instead of Chika.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，今晚我刚在矮桌旁坐下时，脑子里跑过一整段独白，说的是待在这里陪你而不是陪 Chika 感觉有多不对。

lines.en: : Kudos for...not just imagining me with my shirt off, I guess...
lines.zh: : 那我还得谢谢你……没光顾着想象我脱掉上衣的样子，我猜……

lines.en: : I think I was looking at it wrong, though. This isn’t the same place it was back then even if it is the same building.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得我看待它的方式是错的。就算还是同一栋楼，这里也不再是当初那个地方了。

lines.en: : This is your home now. It’s one more sign of you starting over and trying to make something out of yourself when the odds have been stacked up against you from the start.
lines.zh: : 现在是你的家了。这又是一个迹象，说明你在重新开始——在从一开始就对你极其不利的处境里，努力活出点样子。

lines.en: : I’m so proud of you, Yumi. Even if you are still a total bitch.
lines.zh: : 我为你感到非常骄傲，Yumi。就算你依然是个彻头彻尾的婊子。

lines.en: : Thanks...that means a lot...even if it’s coming from a serial groomer who stops being attracted to girls once they graduate high school.
lines.zh: : 谢谢……这对我意义重大……哪怕这话出自一个惯于诱骗女生的家伙之口——而且人家一高中毕业，他就不再感兴趣了。

lines.en: : We’re caught in a timeloop, Yumi. You’re not graduating any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我们可是困在时间循环里的，Yumi。你短期内不会毕业的。

lines.en: : I don’t want to make things harder for Chika...And Noriko-
lines.zh: : 我不想让 Chika 更难做……还有 Noriko——

lines.en: : Oh, right. She wanted us to film this, didn’t she?
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。她不是想让我们把这段拍下来吗？

lines.en: : Film what? What are...what’s...I-
lines.zh: : 拍什么？什么……什么是……我——

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss22
: Whh...whtrr...mmn?!
scene yumifirstrealkiss23
: Mmmh...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯……

lines.en: I have my moments. Everyone does.
lines.zh: 我也有这样的时刻。每个人都有。

lines.en: And it matters not that the weather never changes here when I hold in my hands the key to the clouds.
lines.zh: 而当我手里握着云的钥匙时，这里的天气永不改变，也就无关紧要了。

lines.en: A drought can only last so long — and if I’m ever to reach a world where it always rains, I will need to spur those same clouds to action every now and again.
lines.zh: 干旱总有个尽头——而如果我要抵达那个永远下雨的世界，我就需要时不时地催一催那些云。

lines.en: I have learned from my mistakes. Not to the point where I will no longer make them, though. I just make {i}better{/i} ones now. Like relying on my lips instead of my tongue.
lines.zh: 我吸取了教训。虽然还没到不会再犯错的程度。我只是犯{i}更好{/i}的错了。比如仰仗我的嘴唇，而不是我的舌头。

lines.en: Like not reaching into her shirt and tearing her sarashi clean off to see what she’s been hiding from me.
lines.zh: 比如没有把手伸进她的衣服，把那条 sarashi 一把扯下来，看看她一直藏着什么。

lines.en: Like not backing down this time when I think we both felt like I would.
lines.zh: 比如这一次，在我们俩都以为我会退缩的时候，我没有退。

lines.en: Something’s changed in her. And I don’t know if it’s just that I’ve worn her down by now, but I don’t care.
lines.zh: 她身上有什么变了。我不知道是不是只是我把她磨够了，但我不在乎。

lines.en: A collector collects. And I intend to cherish and protect this part of it the only way I know how...
lines.zh: 收藏家就是会收藏。而我打算用我唯一会的方式，去珍惜并守护这一部分……

lines.en: By obsessing over her in the beginning, giving her the most coveted spot atop my mantle, then subtly moving her downward while she sleeps so that she doesn’t know she’s moved at all.
lines.zh: 一开始疯狂地迷恋她，把她放在我壁炉架上最令人艳羡的位置，然后在她睡着时慢慢把她往下挪，让她根本不知道自己被挪过。

lines.en: In this moment, though, where everything else fades into the background, there is nothing I want more than to give her the love she deserves the most. One that’s black and broken. Unrelenting, undeserved.
lines.zh: 但在这一刻，当其他一切都退进背景里时，我最想做的，莫过于给她她最应得的那份爱。一份漆黑而破碎的爱。不依不饶，也不配得到。

lines.en: It isn’t {i}true{/i} love.
lines.zh: 这不是{i}真爱{/i}。

lines.en: But it’s something close.
lines.zh: 但也相当接近了。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss24
: Uhhhhhhhh........
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃…………

lines.en: : Did you hate it?
lines.zh: : 你讨厌吗？

lines.en: : Did I...hate it?
lines.zh: : 我……讨厌吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. This is a great chance to save face and tell me you didn’t want this. And that I’m just being a creepy old dude with a thing for teenagers again.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这可是个保全面子的好机会——告诉我你并不想要这个，告诉我我又是个对女高中生有想法的恶心大叔。

lines.en: : Just think of how much you could get me to grovel if I forced myself on you a second time.
lines.zh: : 想想看，如果我说我是第二次强迫了你，你能让我跪在地上求你原谅到什么程度。
: 你什么？……

lines.en: : I don’t...know what happens now...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……接下来会发生什么……

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : Like...do we...
lines.zh: : 就是……我们要……

lines.en: : I don’t...think I’m ready for...anything else yet...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得我还没准备好……做别的事……

lines.en: : Well, that’s good. Because this is all we’re doing today.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那正好。因为我们今天只做这些。

lines.en: : {i}Today?...{/i}So-
: The floodgates have opened. It took a while, but you’ve finally been successfully indoctrinated into the harem.
lines.zh: : 闸门已经打开了。虽然花了点时间，但你终于成功被吸纳进后宫了。

lines.en: : Is that really something you should be saying right after taking my first real kiss?
lines.zh: : 你刚夺走我真正的初吻，就说这种话真的合适吗？

lines.en: : I’ll be taking a lot of other firsts from you soon. It’s best to get used to it now while they’re all still painless.
lines.zh: : 我不久之后还要从你这里拿走很多别的「第一次」。趁现在这些都还不痛，你最好早点习惯。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss25
: O...Other firsts?! {i}Painless?!{/i} What are you...why are you standing up? What do I do now?!
lines.zh: : 别……别的第一次？！{i}不痛{/i}？！你在……你为什么站起来了？我现在该怎么办？！

lines.en: : Say goodnight, I guess. I need to get out of here before I start acting out more of my internal monologue and you wind up with one less sarashi.
lines.zh: : 说晚安吧，大概。我得赶紧走，免得我把更多内心独白演出来，最后让你少一条 sarashi。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss26
: Wait, you’re leaving?! Just like that?! But you didn’t even drink any of the gross ass tea I made for you! That’s, like...rude as fuck, isn’t it?!
lines.zh: : 等等，你这就走了？！就这么走了？！可你连我给你泡的那杯难喝到死的茶都没喝！这也太……太他妈没礼貌了吧？！

lines.en: : A little, yeah. I’m trying not to dismantle any of your more “traditional values,” though. So this is necessary for your continued preservation, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 是有点，没错。不过我在努力不去拆掉你那些更「传统的价值观」。所以这一步是必要的，为了让你继续保持原样，Yumi。

lines.en: : So, we’re like...this is a {i}thing{/i} now? Because it...I know I’m the one who invited you up here and shit. But it still feels like it came out of nowhere and I’m not really sure if you’re just fucking with me again!
lines.zh: : 所以，我们算是……这就是{i}事儿{/i}了？因为……我知道是我把你请上来的。可这一切还是来得毫无预兆，我真的不确定你是不是又在耍我！

lines.en: : I’m not fucking with you, Yumi. This is a thing now.
lines.zh: : 我没有耍你，Yumi。这就是事儿了。

lines.en: : Okay, but what kind of thing is it?! You’re not gonna tell anybody, are you?! Because if you tell anybody, I’ll...I’ll kill you! I mean it!
lines.zh: : 好，可这是哪种事儿？！你不会告诉任何人吧？！因为如果你告诉任何人，我就……我就杀了你！我是认真的！

lines.en: : I’m actually on my way to tell Chika, Noriko, {i}and{/i} your mom right now. Expect some phone calls in the next couple hours.
lines.zh: : 其实我现在就准备去告诉 Chika、Noriko {i}和{/i}你妈。接下来的几个小时内请留意来电。

lines.en: : Don’t you fucking dare, Sensei! You...you forced me again! I didn’t consent to any of this!
lines.zh: : 你他妈敢，Sensei！你……你又强迫我了！这些我可都没同意！

lines.en: : Oh, really? Okay. I guess we’ll just never do it again then. Later.
lines.zh: : 哦，真的吗？好吧。那我想我们以后就再也不做了。回见。

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss27
: G...Good! Go find somebody your own age! And...delete my number in your phone! I’ve had it up to here with your groomy, rapey bullshit!
lines.zh: : 很……很好！去找个跟你同岁的吧！还有……把我号码从你手机里删了！你这套诱骗加强奸的破事我已经受够了！

lines.en: : {i}Can’t hear you. Already on my way home.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}听不见。已经在回家的路上了。{/i}

lines.en: : Good! Then...try not to groom or rape anybody on the way, asshole!
lines.zh: : 好！那……路上别去诱骗或强奸任何人，混蛋！

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss28
: Asshole...
lines.zh: : 混蛋……

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss29
: I can’t believe he just...did that...
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信他就这么……做了……

lines.en: : Fucking creep. He’s like...twice my age. And saying I’m a part of his fucking {i}harem{/i} now? Like...what the fuck?
lines.zh: : 死变态。他都……比我大一倍了。还说我现在是他那破{i}后宫{/i}的一员？什么……什么鬼啊？

lines.en: : You’re really picking {i}now{/i} to stay quiet, Parei-
lines.zh: : 你还真挑{i}这时候{/i}安静下来啊，Parei——

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss30
: Hello and welcome back to Untitled Children’s Show!
lines.zh: : 大家好，欢迎回到《无名儿童节目》！

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss31
: I’m your host — {b}ME.{/b} And joining me today is a {i}very{/i} special guest — a real, live god!
lines.zh: : 我是你们的主持人——也就是{b}我{/b}。今天来到节目的是一位{i}非常{/i}特别的嘉宾——一位货真价实、活生生的神！

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss32
: Why don’t you go ahead and introduce yourself to all of the viewers at home who aren’t exactly familiar with you yet?
lines.zh: : 要不你先向家里那些还不太熟悉你的观众们自我介绍一下？

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss33
how about you bite me? i was supposed to be getting some secondhand action with my favorite yakuza princess and her teacher right now. this is clearly an abuse of power and you know it.
lines.zh: 要不你咬我啊？我本来正打算借我最爱的黑道公主和她的老师搞点间接刺激呢。这明显是滥用职权，你心知肚明。

lines.en: : Exerting power over the powerless is exactly what your princess does though, isn’t it? And what you do as well! So the two of you really {i}are{/i} a great match for one another!
lines.zh: : 对无力者施加权力，不正是你那位公主干的事吗？你也一样！所以你们俩{i}真是{/i}天造地设的一对！

lines.en: : One thing we’re all dying to know, though, is what’s going to happen next! What’s your plan, Pareidolia? To return to a mind that has already purged you once? In clear violation of the Code of Joy?
lines.zh: : 不过我们都特别想知道的是——接下来会发生什么！你有什么打算，Pareidolia？要回到一个已经把你清除过一次的脑子里去吗？公然违反《喜悦法典》？

lines.en: : A mind that’s already purged you once?...
lines.zh: : 一个已经把你清除过一次的脑子？……

lines.en: yumi. get me out of here. click your heels three times or something. fuck if i know how it works.
lines.zh: yumi. 把我弄出去。把鞋跟并起来敲三下什么的。天知道这玩意儿到底怎么运作。

lines.en: : What’s that...weird Maya talking about it? What’s the “Code of Joy?”
lines.zh: : 那个……怪 Maya 在说什么呢？「喜悦法典」是什么？

lines.en: a bunch of godly gobbledygook, that’s what. you just focus on training that little mouth of yours for some good old-fashioned teacher dick.
lines.zh: 一堆神的胡言乱语，就那么回事。你只管专心练好你那张小嘴，好来点老派的老师鸡巴。

lines.en: : Ooh! Wrong answer!
lines.zh: : 哦哦！回答错误！

lines.en: scene yumifirstrealkiss34
: What we were looking for was π! Which means that, unfortunately, we’ll need to conclude today’s episode a little early!
lines.zh: : 我们要找的答案是 π！这意味着，很遗憾，今天的节目得稍微提前收场了！

lines.en: : That’s okay, though! Because we’ve got plenty more {b}FUN{/b} in store for you soon!
lines.zh: : 不过没关系！因为我们很快还会有更多「{b}乐趣{/b}」等着大家！

lines.en: : Don’t change that channel! Here’s Horseface Taki with the weather.
lines.zh: : 别换台！下面交给 Horseface Taki 播报天气。

it never changes.
lines.zh: 它永远不会变。

lines.zh: 就算有钥匙也不会。
